quote: And God granted the request of Jabez.

q: In 1 Chronicles, why should we give thanks to the LORD?
quote: Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.

q: In 1 Chronicles, what did King David tell Solomon before building the temple?

q: In 1 Chronicles, why did David make lavish preparations for the temple?

quote: My son Solomon is young and inexperienced, and the house to be built for the LORD must be exceedingly magnificent

q: In David's prayer in 1 Chronicles, to whom does everything in heaven and earth belong?
quote: for everything in heaven and on earth belongs to You.

q: In 1 Chronicles, where did David say the people's generous gifts came from?

q: In 1 Chronicles, why did Saul die?
a: He was unfaithful to the LORD
quote: So Saul died for his unfaithfulness to the LORD

q: In 1 Chronicles, how is King David described at his death?
a: Full of years, riches, and honor
quote: He died at a ripe old age, full of years, riches, and honor

q: In 1 Chronicles, what did Satan incite David to do?
quote: Then Satan rose up against Israel and incited David to take a census of Israel.

q: In 1 Chronicles, to which prophet did David say the ark was under a tent?
why: David lived in a cedar house.
quote: he said to Nathan the prophet, “Here I am, living in a house of cedar, while the ark of the covenant of the LORD is under a tent.”
